mantras.translation: The Puruṣa has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Encompassing the earth on all sides, He stood beyond it by ten fingers’ breadth.

mantras.title: Sri Sukta Opening
mantras.description: Opening of the Śrī Sūkta
mantras.text: हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम्। चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह॥
mantras.translation: O Jātavedas, bring to me Lakṣmī—golden-hued, deer-like, adorned with gold and silver, moon-like, made of gold.

mantras.title: Medha Suktam Opening
mantras.description: Prayer for medhā (intelligence)
mantras.text: मेधा देवी जुषमाणा न आगात् विश्वाची भद्रा सुमनस्यमाना। त्वया जुष्टा जुषमाणा दुरुक्तान् बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
mantras.translation: May Goddess Medhā, gracious and auspicious, come to us facing all ways. Favoured by you, may we speak greatly in the assembly as brave ones, free from harsh speech.

mantras.title: Durga Suktam Opening
mantras.description: Opening of the Durgā Sūkta
mantras.text: जातवेदसे सुनवाम सोममरातीयतो निदहाति वेदः। स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा नावेव सिन्धुं दुरितात्यग्निः॥
mantras.translation: To Jātavedas we press Soma; may He burn away the knowledge of our enemies. May Agni carry us across all difficulties and evils, as a boat across a river.

mantras.title: Narayana Upanishad Mantra
mantras.description: Core mantra from the Nārāyaṇa Upaniṣad tradition
mantras.text: ॐ नारायणाय विद्महे वासुदेवाय धीमहि। तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात्॥
mantras.translation: Om. We meditate on Nārāyaṇa, on Vāsudeva. May that Viṣṇu inspire us.

mantras.title: Rudra Gayatri
mantras.description: Gāyatrī of Rudra-Śiva
mantras.text: ॐ तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि। तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात्॥
mantras.translation: Om. We meditate on that Puruṣa, on Mahādeva. May Rudra inspire us.

mantras.title: Narasimha Gayatri
mantras.description: Gāyatrī of Narasiṃha
mantras.text: ॐ वज्रनखाय विद्महे तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राय धीमहि। तन्नो नारसिंहः प्रचोदयात्॥
mantras.translation: Om. We meditate on the thunderbolt-clawed, sharp-fanged one. May Narasiṃha inspire us.

mantras.title: Hayagriva Gayatri
mantras.description: Gāyatrī of Hayagrīva
mantras.text: ॐ वागीश्वराय विद्महे हयग्रीवाय धीमहि। तन्नो हंसः प्रचोदयात्॥
mantras.translation: Om. We meditate on the Lord of speech, Hayagrīva. May that Swan inspire us.

mantras.title: Sudarshana Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Viṣṇu’s discus
mantras.text: ॐ क्लीं कृष्णाय गोविन्दाय गोपीजनवल्लभाय पराया नमः। ॐ सहस्रार हुं फट्॥
mantras.translation: Om. Salutations to Kṛṣṇa-Govinda, beloved of the gopīs, the Supreme. Om. Thousand-spoked (discus)—hūṁ phaṭ.

mantras.title: Garuda Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra associated with Garuḍa
mantras.text: ॐ पक्षिराजाय विद्महे स्वर्णपक्षाय धीमहि। तन्नो गरुडः प्रचोदयात्॥
mantras.translation: Om. We meditate on the king of birds, golden-winged. May Garuḍa inspire us.

mantras.title: Ayyappa Mantra
mantras.description: Traditional Śabarimalā nāma
mantras.text: स्वामीये शरणं अय्यप्पा। ॐ श्री अय्यप्पाये नमः॥
mantras.translation: Swamiye Śaraṇam Ayyappā. Om. Salutations to Śrī Ayyappa.

mantras.title: Vitthala Mantra
mantras.description: Pandharpur nāma of Viṭṭhala
mantras.text: जय जय विठ्ठल जय हरि विठ्ठल। ज्ञानदेव तुकाराम विठ्ठल विठ्ठल॥
mantras.translation: Victory to Viṭṭhala, victory to Hari Viṭṭhala—remembered with Jñāneśvar and Tukārām.

mantras.title: Jagannatha Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Lord Jagannātha of Puri
mantras.text: ॐ नमो भगवते जगन्नाथाय। नीलाचलेशाय नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om. Salutations to the Blessed Lord Jagannātha, Lord of Nīlācala.

mantras.title: Balaji Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Śrī Veṅkaṭeśwara
mantras.text: ॐ नमो वेङ्कटेशाय। श्रीनिवासाय नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om. Salutations to Veṅkaṭeśa. Salutations to Śrīnivāsa.

mantras.title: Meenakshi Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Goddess Mīnākṣī
mantras.text: ॐ ह्रीं मीनाक्ष्यै नमः। मातङ्ग्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Hrīṁ Mīnākṣyai Namaḥ. Salutations to Mātaṅgī-Mīnākṣī.

mantras.title: Kamakshi Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Kāmākṣī of Kāñcī
mantras.text: ॐ क्लीं कामाक्ष्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Klīṁ Kāmākṣyai Namaḥ — salutations to Kāmākṣī.

mantras.title: Visalakshi Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Viśālākṣī of Vārāṇasī
mantras.text: ॐ ह्रीं विशालाक्ष्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Hrīṁ Viśālākṣyai Namaḥ — salutations to Viśālākṣī.

mantras.title: Bala Tripurasundari Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Bālā Tripurasundarī
mantras.text: ॐ ऐं क्लीं सौः बालायै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Aiṁ Klīṁ Sauḥ Bālāyai Namaḥ — salutations to Bālā.

mantras.title: Chhinnamasta Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Chhinnamastā (Mahāvidyā)
mantras.text: ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं ऐं वज्रवैरोचनीये हूं हूं फट् स्वाहा॥
mantras.translation: Traditional bīja mantra of Chhinnamastā — recite with guidance from a qualified teacher.

mantras.title: Bagalamukhi Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Goddess Bagalāmukhī
mantras.text: ॐ ह्लीं बगलामुखि सर्वदुष्टानां वाचं मुखं पदं स्तम्भय जिह्वां कीलय बुद्धिं विनाशय ह्लीं ॐ स्वाहा॥
mantras.translation: Om Hlīṁ Bagalāmukhi—stun the speech, mouth and feet of all the wicked; nail the tongue; destroy (hostile) intellect—Hlīṁ Om Svāhā.

mantras.title: Matangi Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Goddess Mātaṅgī
mantras.text: ॐ ह्रीं क्लीं हूँ मातङ्ग्यै फट् स्वाहा॥
mantras.translation: Om Hrīṁ Klīṁ Hūṁ Mātaṅgyai Phaṭ Svāhā.

mantras.title: Dhumavati Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Goddess Dhūmāvatī
mantras.text: ॐ धूं धूं धूमावत्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Dhūṁ Dhūṁ Dhūmāvatyai Namaḥ.

mantras.title: Bhuvaneshwari Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Bhuvaneśvarī
mantras.text: ॐ ह्रीं भुवनेश्वर्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Hrīṁ Bhuvaneśvaryai Namaḥ.

mantras.title: Tripura Bhairavi Mantra
mantras.description: Mantra of Tripura Bhairavī
mantras.text: ॐ हसैं हसकरीं हसैं त्रिपुरभैरव्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Hasaiṁ Hasakarīṁ Hasaiṁ Tripurabhairavyai Namaḥ.

mantras.title: Sodashi Tripura Mantra
mantras.description: Pañcadaśī / Ṣoḍaśī related invocation (short form)
mantras.text: ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं ऐं सौः षोडश्यै नमः॥
mantras.translation: Om Śrīṁ Hrīṁ Klīṁ Aiṁ Sauḥ Ṣoḍaśyai Namaḥ — short form; full ṣoḍaśī is received from a guru.
